newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Tutu has prostate cancer surgery - radio.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Tutu has prostate cancer surgery - radio.

text.p: South African Nobel peace laureate Desmond Tutu has been diagnosed as suffering from prostate cancer and has had most of the gland removed, South African radio said on Friday.

It quoted Tutu's spokesman, John Allen, as saying the Nobel laureate was being examined to determine how serious the disease was and if it had spread, but a urologist had already removed "the bulk of the gland".
